name: Brand rules
observations: Edits are 45 seconds max; cut every pause longer than half a second
No filler words (um, uh) in the edit or the captions

Default caption style is Yellow Serif Kinetic; the older word-by-word yellow captions (reel skill: 3 words per line, the spoken word highlighted in yellow #FFD400) are used only when the owner asks for them

Caption style: Yellow Serif Kinetic (skill yellow-serif): white heavy serif captions, key words warm yellow #FBC238, motions typing / pop / burst / shine / flash, near-black #08090B backgrounds; guide in .claude/skills/yellow-serif/GUIDE.md
Cover text: 3 words max, all caps, the last word in yellow #FFD400
Titles: under 60 characters, plain and specific, no clickbait
Voice: direct and friendly, short sentences, plain words, the way the owner talks

Sermon highlights: never show the slides from the original RAW livestream (no slide half, no split-screen slide cards, no full-screen slide stills). Use only the speaker angle: a vertical 9:16 crop of the speaker from the stage camera (the right half of the 1920x1080 livestream frame, the strip at y 297-837), framed from the head to just below the top of the podium and kept centred on the speaker as he or she moves. Everything else stays as before: phone B-roll cutaways, motion graphics, Yellow Serif Kinetic captions, music and transitions continue as usual.

Motion: every edit is animation-heavy. All on-screen text animates in (no static text cards), and there is at least one motion-graphic element (kinetic title, animated lower-third, animated shape or icon, animated transition) every 10 seconds of runtime.

Post captions (YouTube descriptions, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, pinned comment) never include a credit line with the speaker's name or the sermon / series title (e.g. no "Rev Damien Chua ·《认识神的声音》"). The caption is the message only, plus hashtags.
Write percentages as numbers with % (e.g. 100%), never as 巴仙 (e.g. not 一百巴仙), in captions, titles and on-screen text, even when the interpreter says 巴仙.

Board naming: when a clip's video, thumbnail and caption are all ready, its task is called 'Final · <clip title>' (never 'Thumbnail · …' or 'Captions · …'), so the owner knows it is ready to post. The app also marks such tasks with a green ✓ Final tag.

Sound effects: every video gets real CC0 sound effects from the sfx skill (found with the Openverse API), one for each designed move and hit, each sound's loudest moment on the exact frame of its motion; never synthesized beeps, never sound on plain cuts or karaoke words.

Framing for vertical edits from 16:9 footage: 9:16 means zoom each shot to fill 1080x1920, framed on its subject. Only group photos keep the full 16:9 picture (over a blurred fill). Never put every shot on a blurred fill (owner, 2026-10-28, t25).

Ongoing Sermon service-poster default, explicitly clarified 2026-10-28: when creating speaker/service editions, automatically use the user's ten speaker/name/date/time poster references together with the chosen sermon master as actual visual generation inputs. Design exact sermon titles, bilingual speaker names and checked date/12-hour time as one coherent complete picture matching the selected poster's visual family. Do not default to editable text overlays, fixed information cards, or an optional reference-style switch the user must reselect. Originals and all prior approved/frozen versions remain preserved; original speaker facial pixels are composited outside image generation and never repainted/beautified. Reference-pack profile: D:/AI OFFICE/references/sermon-service-info/20261028/profile.json. Foreign example faces/logos/dates/names/wording must not enter the user's final artwork. Final raster lettering and overall integration require actual visual review and user OK; no automatic generation/publishing/Pulse resumption is implied by saving this preference.

Ongoing sermon service-picture correction (2026-10-28.2): omit internal gathering labels from visible posters. Keep both exact Chinese/English speaker names together adjacent to their own larger upper-body portrait, using the same anchor across the artwork group. New v4 editions use local alpha-only background removal while preserving original decoded RGB/faces, original uploads and matte provenance; no editable name cards or facial regeneration. Old frozen editions/exports remain untouched. Actual rendered integration and lettering still require visual review and user OK. Evidence: D:/AI OFFICE/.studio/intake/sermon-portrait-blend-20261028/. This explicit preference update does not resume Pulse or publish.
Channel topics (main channel, NLRCC): sermon highlights, church life and events, faith for everyday life; aimed at church members, non-believers, young people and families (owner, 2026-10-28).

Posting (owner, 2026-10-29): every finished clip goes to Facebook, Instagram and YouTube Shorts at the same time with one Approve & post, and to TikTok drafts once TikTok is connected (the owner adds the caption and posts it in the TikTok app; until connected, TikTok is posted by hand). The owner picks one caption, used on every platform. Thumbnails come in two sizes, always: 9:16 on YouTube and Facebook, 3:4 on Instagram (TikTok can't take a custom thumbnail).

name: Lessons
observations: [Social · for Shop, Creative] When a caption is made punchier or more motivating, keep every hedge and condition the speaker used (常常/often, 如果/if, 若是) and check each rewritten line against its captions.srt line before the brand check. On World FM or God FM, the punchy rewrite dropped 常常 twice (不是你选的, 祂的智慧很不一样), and the brand-checker had to restore both.

[Shop · for Social, Scripts] Write post copy in the relay post.md layout from the first draft: Plan, YouTube Shorts, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and Pinned comment, with 2-3 options each and at most 3/5/3/4 hashtags (YouTube/Instagram/Facebook/TikTok). Never take a place or date tag from a folder name. World FM v1 was one caption with 15 hashtags and "10/25 PJ" (only a folder name), and it had to be fully rewritten.

[Creative · for Social, Scripts] For sermon covers, use the interpreter's own Chinese words on two rows, with the answer row in gold (white 世界的频道 over gold 天国的频道), placed over the chest (y about 820-1180) and well below the face (y about 230-560). The owner picked this layout from 4 options and approved it with no corrections.

[Creative · for Creative] Before planning a Poster Kinetic cover in a follow-up run, check the allow list. If the pixel tool is the only renderer allowed, it can't slant or extrude text, gives one colour per row and puts each space-separated word on its own row. So write at most 2 short rows, one colour each, and no mixed-colour hero line like "World FM or God FM?".

[Social · for Social, Creative] Write 2-3 caption options in post.md under '## Captions', each with a 'Title:' line and a caption that works on Facebook, Instagram and YouTube as is: the owner picks one and it goes everywhere, so never split one idea across platform sections.
[Social · for Social] No file paths, 'Video:' or 'For Facebook…' notes inside post.md options: they ended up as the YouTube title and description on the damien-1025 clip.

[Creative · for Creative] One owner per job: the clip-editor delivers one captioned video and one cover.jpg per clip; the thumbnail-designer only steps in when the brand-checker fails a cover or the owner asks for options. Duplicate covers and caption versions confused the review.
[Creative · for Creative, Social] Keep posted files next to post.md and working files in work/, so the posting overview finds the right video and thumbnail.

[Creative · for Social, Shop] Speech-recognition captions get Chinese measure words wrong: before rendering, read captions.srt for 量词 mismatches (话 takes 句, not 个) and fix every occurrence, then use the same corrected wording in briefs, notes.md and post.md. On 一句话的力量 the ASR wrote 每一个说话 in two captions (6.3 s and 11.9 s) and the owner had to correct it to 每一句说话 after approval.

[Creative · for Creative] When an edit is rendered from a project outside the office (e.g. a Remotion project on the owner's D: drive), note in the clip's notes.md the exact project path, composition id, the data file and cue to change, and the render + audio-mux command, so a caption fix is a one-line edit and re-render. On 一句话的力量 the fix needed a search to find data-h1.json and render.mjs.

[Creative · for Social, Shop] Check speech-recognition captions for homophones against the sermon's own key verse and the line next to them: the sermon text (箴言 25:11 一句话说得合宜) says 合宜, not 合意, and 时候是对的 follows 'right timing', not 事实是对的. On 一句称赞 · 冰皮月饼 the owner corrected both after approval.

[Creative · for Creative] A caption the edit's own notes flag as uncertain ('check by ear') must be resolved or asked about before the video goes to Waiting for my OK, never shipped as is. 我就拿一球上来 was flagged in the draft notes, went out unchanged, and the owner corrected it to 一块.

[Creative · for Creative, Scripts] Interpreted sermons: the owner wants only the main speaker's voice, never the interpreter. Before cutting, check whether the source audio has an interpreter in it (the 10/18 Rev Hiew sermon audio is one mono mix of both voices). Transcribe each chosen range and keep only the speaker's own language, cutting out every interpreter phrase, even short ones at the start or end of a range. Then listen to the final mix once for any second voice before the edit goes to Waiting for my OK. On 只把我所有的给你 · 灯塔 the interpreter stayed in the mix, and the owner had to ask for it to be removed after review.

[Creative · for Creative] In clip notes.md, write where the speech comes from: the audio file, whether an interpreter is in it, and how each voice was kept or cut. Then an audio-only fix can be planned without opening the project. The 灯塔 notes named 1018.mp3 but didn't say an interpreter was in it.

[Creative · for Social, Scripts] When a post cover uses a template, write each headline row's colour into the Studio's visual-direction (instructions) field, matched to the template's rows (for Golden Apple: row 1 red, row 2 gold, like 金苹果 / Golden Apple). On 一句话的力量 the instructions field was empty, and the prompt only said 'follow its text hierarchy, palette'. Only 1 of the 4 options kept the red/gold split (option 3: 一句话 red, 的力量 gold), and that is the one the owner approved with no corrections.

[Creative · for Creative] For template covers, give each of the four options its own variation (layout, crop or type treatment) so the owner gets four real choices. On 一句话的力量 all four used the same prompt and came back nearly identical (same apple, checkerboard, crown and title split). The only difference was the title colour.

[Creative · for Creative] For 9:16 edits made from 16:9 footage, zoom every shot to fill 1080x1920 centred on its subject, and keep the full 16:9 over a blurred fill only for posed group photos. The rule covers every layout, including the opening. On t25 孩子们动手做甜点, v1 put every shot on blur and the owner corrected it; in v2 the brand-checker failed the torn-paper opening because the picture sat in the top half.

[Creative · for Creative] Choose each shot's crop centre and write its label after looking at 3 frames (start, middle, end), not one middle frame, because the camera moves within a 2 s shot. On t25 the toddler's face only came in at about 0.7 s and the puppet at 1.2 s, and the brand-checker failed 认真听 and 一起玩 for describing children who weren't in those shots.

[Creative · for Creative] yellow-serif render.py keeps every label on screen 0.35 s after its end time. For labels tied to a shot, set end to the cut time minus 0.35 s, then check one frame just after each cut. On t25 the brand-checker found 小小厨师 over the leader and 小玩偶 over the kids in the next shot.

[Social · for Social, Creative] When a post.md option reuses on-screen labels as its title, write it only after the labels pass the brand check, and update post.md in the same pass whenever a label changes. On t25 option 3 used 一起玩，认真听; 认真听 didn't match its shot, became 一起看 in v2, and post.md had to be fixed separately to 一起看，一起玩.

[Creative · for Creative, Social] Owner approved 孩子们动手做甜点 v2 (2026-10-28): for a no-speech event montage, per-shot 9:16 zoom with slow push/pull and cut punches, a short on-screen label every 2-4 s naming only what is visible, two brush bursts, light-leak transitions and SFX on each move is the accepted 'fun review video' recipe.

[Creative · for Creative, Analytics] Sandy 一句话的力量 (2026-10-28): the transcript misheard 每一句说话 in two places (6.3s, 11.9s). Before rendering a sermon highlight, read every caption cue against the audio and fix misheard Chinese phrases; a repeated key phrase is usually misheard the same way each time it comes up.

[Creative · for Creative, Social] On mixed speaker + interpreter audio, speech-to-text sometimes hears the English as Chinese words. Also check every key line against the sermon's own verse. On 只把我所有的给你 · 灯塔 (t21), an interpreter's "…will not meet danger" had turned into a 但是 in the caption, and 所有的 (Acts 3:6, the reel title) had been heard as 有的. The owner confirmed 所有的 by ear after review. When you cut out the interpreter, drop the caption words that fall inside each cut, and compare the caption line that has the reel title against the verse.

[Creative · for Creative, Dev] Before you change an approved edit, write a 'Locked' list in the plan (audio, shots, caption wording and timing). Put all new code behind a version flag such as motionV>=2 so other reels that share the project render byte-identical, and back up every changed file as *_prevN. Before review, prove nothing else changed: data-r1/r2 identical, speech/music residual about -82 dB, sfx_verify misaligned 0. The owner approved t53 on 只把我所有的给你 · 灯塔 this way with no corrections.

[Creative · for Social, Scripts] For a sermon reel cover, offer at least one option built on the reel's main picture (here the lighthouse), not only speaker frames. Use the punchline sentence as the headline, word for word the same as post.md Option 1's Title. On 灯塔 the brief asked for a frame of Rev Hiew, but the owner approved a cover with no speaker: a lighthouse photo with 灯塔不能叫风浪停止，但它还可以发出亮光 in 4 rows growing toward 发出亮光, and picked the caption option with the same line.

[Creative · for Creative, Social] For a sermon cover in the Codex thumbnail Studio, start with the owner's own template at 1080x1440 and fill in the instructions field on the first request, not another sermon's template. On 灯塔, t55 and t56 used the Golden Apple template from 一句话的力量 at 1080x1920 with empty instructions, and the owner picked neither. After switching to the owner's template (7dfa84a6, 1080x1440, 'gold and silver') it took until the 5th request (t59) to get an approval.

[Social · for Social, Shop] When a caption quotes the speaker's list, keep every item in the order spoken and check it against captions.srt. On 灯塔, Option 1 said 成为基督的爱、盼望的一个见证, but the speaker said 神的爱、基督的爱、盼望, so 神的爱 went out missing on Facebook, Instagram and YouTube.

[Social · for Social, Creative] Once the cover exists, update the post.md Plan's cover line to name the chosen cover file and its headline. On 灯塔 post.md still said 'Cover: none yet' when the owner scheduled the post with cover-codex.png.

[Creative · for Creative, Social] For a sermon reel cover in the Codex thumbnail Studio, start from that sermon's own series template at the template's size, fill in the instructions field (feeling + key object), and use a real frame from the edit that shows the story's moment, even a listener rather than the preacher. On 一句称赞 · 冰皮月饼 the first request (t63) was approved: Golden Apple template, 1080x1920, 'warm and hopeful, golden apple', the congregation frame at about 28.8 s (原来她在后面). The thumbnail-designer's four pixel speaker-frame covers (cover-1..4, brand-check PASS) went unused, the second sermon reel in a row where that happened.

[Social · for Social, Creative] Once the cover is chosen, put the caption option whose Title matches the cover headline word for word first in post.md, and name it in the Plan's cover line. On both 灯塔 and 一句称赞 · 冰皮月饼 the owner posted the caption that matched the cover. On 一句称赞 that was Option 2 (一句话讲得合宜，就像金苹果), while the Plan still pointed to the unused cover.jpg (一句称赞).

[Social · for Social, Scripts] For a sermon highlight, give at least one caption option the sermon's key verse with its reference as a scripture line (e.g. 「一句话说得合宜，就如金苹果在银网子里。」箴言 25:11), and offer it as a normal choice. On 一句称赞 · 冰皮月饼 the owner picked that option (#箴言), even though the reviewer notes said 'Pick option 1 or 3 if the post should carry only her words'.

[Creative · for Creative, Social] Pong+Gospel 1107 婚姻能长久 was approved and scheduled with no corrections to the video. Reuse its recipe for Pong talks: keep every line in order; cut the crew slate, the crew's lines and the pauses (17 on 1107); switch between a wide and a 1.15x tight framing at each pause cut, with each framing on screen at least 1.2 s; CC0 piano 21 dB under the voice with a 1.5 s tail; one SFX per designed move, peaking on its frame; finish at -14 LUFS.

[Creative · for Creative, Social] Before you start the thumbnail-designer on a finished clip, check its folder for cover-codex.png / cover-codex-ig.png and for a templateId in package.json. If Studio covers already exist, don't start a scripted cover pass. On 1107, t83 made four Poster Kinetic covers (cover-1..4) while the Codex covers were already there (its notes quote the cover-codex.png headline), and the owner posted the Codex pair.

[Social · for Social, Shop, Scripts] When you lengthen a speaker's caption, quote every line of his word for word from notes.md 'What he says', keeping framing words like 可是我相信 and 所以. Added lines may only be an everyday example or the closing question, never a new claim or rebuttal. On 1107, v2 dropped 可是我相信 and added 可是感觉会变淡，缘分也只是一个开始, which Pong never said, and v2 was replaced. v3 Option 1 kept his lines word for word plus one example (忙了一整天，还愿意坐下来听对方说话), and that is the caption that went out.

[Social · for Social, Shop] Check the weekday of every date in the post.md Plan on a calendar, and re-check the Plan with every new caption version instead of copying it forward. On 1107, v1, v2 and v3 all said 'Friday 7 November', but 7 Nov 2026 is a Saturday, the day the post was scheduled.

[Shop · for Social, Creative] When a follow-up brief's numbers clash with Brand rules or Lessons, follow the brain and name the clash in one line of the post.md Plan. On 1107 the t84 brief asked for 8 to 15 hashtags; Lessons cap a shared caption much lower, and the posted Option 1 carried 4.

name: Pong+Gospel · Brand rules
observations: Follow the main "Brand rules" only for what is not set here, and never use the main channel's name, logo, slogans or hashtags for Pong+Gospel.

Never cut the talk (owner, 2026-10-27): keep every sentence Pong says, in order. Remove only pauses, filler sounds (um, ah, ohh, 呃, 啊) and false starts (a line he stops and says again: delete the failed try, keep the full one). This replaces the main rules' 45-second maximum: the length is the whole talk without its pauses.

Editing style (owner, 2026-10-27): Poster Kinetic (poster-kinetic skill) with motion graphics and word animation, sermon-moments only where the words earn it, and real CC0 sound effects from the sfx skill on every designed move and hit. Keep it lively and professional with zoom in / zoom out: alternate a wide and a tight framing at the pause cuts, punch-ins on the hero words. Frame so the captions sit below his chin.

Footage arrives in Google Drive W:/My Drive/PONG/x EDIT/<MMDD>/ (a folder like '1107 08' holds two posting dates, one talk per date). Finished weeks sit in W:/My Drive/PONG/<MMDD>/ as <MMDD>.mp4, <MMDD>.txt (the spoken lines), <MMDD>_<title>.txt (the post), <MMDD>_<title>.jpg and _9x16.jpg covers.
Only Pong's own voice (owner, 2026-10-27): cut crew talk, slates and anyone else speaking before, during or after the take.

Soft background music under the voice on every video (owner, 2026-10-27): a gentle CC0 instrumental (piano or pads, no beat), ducked about 21 dB under his voice while he speaks, with a short tail after the last word.

Thumbnail background follows the title's feeling (owner, 2026-10-27): keep the warm orange-gold PONG look, the same real presenter on the right and the big title on the left, but choose the scene, light and mood for each topic (e.g. a softer, quieter evening room for loneliness; a warm shared home for marriage) instead of repeating one living-room background.

Captions are longer (owner, 2026-10-28): each of the 3 title + caption sets is 6–10 short lines (about 150–250 Chinese characters before the hashtags): a first line that hooks, then 3–6 lines that unpack the message using Pong's own words from captions.srt, one line applying it to everyday life, and a closing question that invites comments; then the hashtags. The 3–4 line captions used before (e.g. 1107 v1) are too short.

Posting time (owner, 2026-10-29): Pong+Gospel posts are scheduled for Saturday 10:00 am by default (the next Saturday at 10 am; the posting screen opens on Schedule with that time, and the owner can still change it or press Post now). Posting plans in post.md use Saturday 10 am as the best time.
